stem.en: An index number of 125 for 2025 with base 2020 = 100 means that prices have:

options.en: risen to 1.25 times their 2020 price in rupees

explanation.en: An index of 125 against a base of 100 means a 25% rise over the base year.

stem.en: Laspeyres' price index uses as weights the quantities of:

options.en: the arithmetic mean of Laspeyres and Paasche
the geometric mean of Laspeyres and Paasche
the harmonic mean of the prices

stem.en: Σp₀q₀ = 400, Σp₁q₀ = 500, Σp₀q₁ = 480, Σp₁q₁ = 576. Find Fisher's price index (one decimal place).
The simple aggregative price index is Σp₁/Σp₀ × 100. Its main weakness is that it:

options.en: is affected by the units in which prices are quoted

explanation.en: A costly item (in its unit) dominates the total, and changing the unit (per kg to per quintal) changes the index.

solution.en: A costly item (in its unit) dominates the total, and changing the unit (per kg to per quintal) changes the index.

stem.en: Moving averages are used mainly to:

options.en: smooth out short-term fluctuations and show the trend

explanation.en: Averaging over a period equal to the cycle removes regular ups and downs and leaves the trend.

stem.en: For quarterly data with a regular seasonal pattern, the best period of the moving average is:

explanation.en: The period should match the length of the cycle: 4 quarters.

stem.en: An even-period (e.g. 4-yearly) moving average must be centred because:

options.en: its values fall between two time points

explanation.en: The average of 4 consecutive values belongs to the middle of the 2nd and 3rd; averaging two successive values centres it on a time point.

solution.en: The average of 4 consecutive values belongs to the middle of the 2nd and 3rd; averaging two successive values centres it on a time point.

stem.en: Sales (in lakh ₹) for 5 years are 20, 24, 22, 26, 30. Find the 3-yearly moving average for the last possible year (one decimal place).

explanation.en: The last 3-yearly average is (22 + 26 + 30)/3 = 26.0, placed against the 4th year.
